result.instructions: Tools for Turso, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our databases use the most rows read this month?"; "List the databases in the default group and their hostnames."; "Run SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'open' on the shop database.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Turso data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run turso_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run turso_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run turso_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. turso_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: turso_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Show the user who owns the API token. Turso API: GET /v1/user.

tools.name: turso_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Show the details of the organization. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}.

tools.name: turso_get_organization_subscription
tools.title: Get the subscription
tools.description: Show the organization's current subscription plan and its details. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/subscription.

tools.name: turso_get_organization_usage
tools.title: Get organization usage
tools.description: Show the organization's billing-cycle usage: rows read and written, and total storage. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/usage.

tools.name: turso_list_organization_members
tools.title: List organization members
tools.description: List the members of the organization and their roles. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/members.

tools.name: turso_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the regions where a Turso group can run databases. Turso API: GET /v1/locations.

tools.name: turso_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups in the organization. A group holds databases in one or more regions. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/groups.

tools.name: turso_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Show one group. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/groups/{groupName}.

tools.name: turso_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List the databases in the organization with their names, hostnames and groups. Optionally filter by group. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/databases.

schema.description: Only databases of this schema database.

parent.description: Only database branches of this parent database id.

tools.name: turso_get_database
tools.title: Get a database
tools.description: Show one database: its name, database id, hostname and block flags. Turso API: GET /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/databases/{databaseName}.

tools.name: turso_get_database_configuration
tools.title: Get database configuration
tools.description: Show a database's settings: size limit, blocked reads and writes, delete protection and allowed IPs. Turso API: GET .../databases/{databaseName}/configuration.

tools.name: turso_list_database_instances
tools.title: List database instances
tools.description: List the instances of one database: the primary and the replicas in each region of its group. Turso API: GET .../databases/{databaseName}/instances.

tools.name: turso_get_database_usage
tools.title: Get database usage
tools.description: Show rows read and written and storage size for one database, per instance and in total. Dates default to the current calendar month. Turso API: GET .../databases/{databaseName}/usage.

from.description: Start date yyyy-mm-dd (default: first day of this month).

tools.name: turso_query_database
tools.title: Run a read-only SQL query
tools.description: Run one SQL statement against a database and return the columns and rows. Turso enforces read-only: writes are rejected. Each call mints a read-only database token that expires after 30 minutes. Uses the libSQL HTTP API (POST https://<hostname>/v2/pipeline).

sql.description: One SQL statement, for example SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10.

args.description: Values for the ? placeholders in the SQL, in order.

tools.name: turso_create_database
tools.title: Create a database
tools.description: Create an empty database in an existing group. The name is lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Creating a database can start billing. Turso API: POST /v1/organizations/{organizationSlug}/databases.

tools.name: turso_create_database_token
tools.title: Create a database token
tools.description: Mint a token for one database. Read-only is the default. The returned JWT is a secret: treat it like a password. Turso API: POST .../databases/{databaseName}/auth/tokens.

expiration.description: How long the token lives, in Turso's format, for example 30m, 1h or 2w1d30m. Omit for a token that never expires.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Turso
prompts.description: What you can do with Turso here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_databases_in_your_organization
prompts.title: Review the databases in your organization
prompts.description: The AI lists your databases, their groups and hostnames, and the group locations. You see what runs where, without opening the Turso dashboard.

prompts.name: find_the_databases_that_use_the_most_rows
prompts.title: Find the databases that use the most rows
prompts.description: The AI reads the usage of each database for a date range, per instance and in total. You see which databases read and write the most rows this month.

prompts.name: ask_questions_of_your_data
prompts.title: Ask questions of your data
prompts.description: The AI runs one read-only SQL query on a database and shows the columns and rows. Turso rejects any write, so the data cannot change.

prompts.name: check_the_plan_and_the_billing_usage
prompts.title: Check the plan and the billing usage
prompts.description: The AI reads your subscription plan and the organization usage for the current billing cycle, so you can see how close you are to the plan limits.

prompts.name: create_a_database_for_a_new_project
prompts.title: Create a database for a new project
prompts.description: The AI creates an empty database in a group you name, then mints a token for it. Creating a database can start billing, so the AI asks you first.
